import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD_A = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD_B = 998244353L;
    static final int MAX_DEPTH = 7;
    static final long MULTIPLIER = 1000000L;

    static long limit, current_order;
    static int total_answer;
    static int[] partial_sums = new int[MAX_DEPTH];
    static List<Integer>[] digits_vectors = new ArrayList[MAX_DEPTH];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DEPTH; i++) {
            digits_vectors[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void generate_sequences(long start, int depth) {
        current_order++;
        int val = (int)(((current_order - start) % MOD_B + MOD_B) % MOD_B);
        digits_vectors[depth].add(val);
        partial_sums[depth] = (int)((partial_sums[depth] + val) % MOD_A);
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            generate_sequences(start * 10 + digit, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    static void process_number(long x) {
        if (x > limit) return;
        if (x * MULTIPLIER + MULTIPLIER - 1 <= limit && x * MULTIPLIER * 10 > limit) {
            long saved_order = current_order;
            for (int depth = 0, factor = 1; depth <= 6; depth++, factor *= 10) {
                int size = digits_vectors[depth].size();
                int diff = (int)(((saved_order - x * factor) % MOD_B + MOD_B) % MOD_B);
                int target = (int)((MOD_B - diff) + 0);
                int position = lowerBound(digits_vectors[depth], target);
                total_answer = (int)((total_answer + 1L * diff * size + partial_sums[depth]) % MOD_A);
                total_answer = (int)((total_answer - 1L * MOD_B * (size - position) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A);
                current_order += size;
            }
            return;
        }
        current_order++;
        int addVal = (int)(((current_order - x) % MOD_B + MOD_B) % MOD_B);
        total_answer = (int)((total_answer + addVal) % MOD_A);
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            process_number(x * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        limit = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        current_order = 0;
        generate_sequences(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(digits_vectors[i]);
        }
        current_order = 0;
        total_answer = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            process_number(i);
        }
        System.out.println(total_answer);
    }
}
